title: At the grocery store
description: Finding items, asking prices and paying at the till.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry! W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Szukam chleba i mleka.
lines.english: Good morning. I'm looking for bread and milk.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Chleb jest na drugiej półce po lewej, a mleko w lodówce z tyłu.
lines.english: The bread is on the second shelf on the left, and the milk is in the fridge at the back.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. How much does this bread cost?
lines.note: ile kosztuje = how much does it cost

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Four zloty fifty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Poproszę dwa. Czy mają państwo świeże jabłka?
lines.english: Two, please. Do you have fresh apples?
lines.note: poproszę = polite 'I'll have / please give me'

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, dzisiaj są przecenione. Kilogram kosztuje sześć złotych.
lines.english: Yes, they are on sale today. A kilo costs six zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: In that case I'll take a kilo.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Anything else?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No, thank you. That's everything.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Razem dwadzieścia jeden złotych. Płaci pan kartą czy gotówką?
lines.english: Twenty-one zloty altogether. Are you paying by card or cash?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: By card. Can I have the receipt?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course, here you are. Have a nice day!

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, you too. Goodbye.
lines.note: nawzajem = likewise / same to you

title: At the barbershop
description: Asking for a haircut, describing the length you want, and paying.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry! Czy jest pan umówiony?
lines.english: Good morning! Do you have an appointment?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Nie, czy jest wolny termin teraz?
lines.english: Good morning. No, is there a free slot right now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, proszę usiąść. Jak pana ostrzyc?
lines.english: Yes, please take a seat. How would you like your hair cut?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Poproszę krótko po bokach i trochę dłużej na górze.
lines.english: Short on the sides and a bit longer on top, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Na jaką długość po bokach? Numer dwa czy trzy?
lines.english: What length on the sides? Number two or three?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Number two, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: And shall we keep the fringe?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Tak, ale proszę skrócić ją odrobinę.
lines.english: Yes, but please shorten it a little.
lines.note: odrobinę = just a little bit

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Would you like your beard trimmed as well?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Tak, proszę wyrównać i skrócić o pół centymetra.
lines.english: Yes, please even it out and take off half a centimetre.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: All done. Do you like it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Very good, thank you. How much do I pay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Strzyżenie i broda to sześćdziesiąt złotych.
lines.english: The haircut and beard come to sixty zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Here you are. Keep the change.
lines.note: reszty nie trzeba = keep the change

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you! Come again.

title: At the pharmacy
description: Describing symptoms and buying medicine without a prescription.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Od wczoraj boli mnie gardło.
lines.english: Good morning. My throat has been hurting since yesterday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Czy ma pan gorączkę albo katar?
lines.english: Do you have a fever or a runny nose?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Trochę katar, ale gorączki nie mam.
lines.english: A bit of a runny nose, but no fever.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proponuję tabletki do ssania i syrop.
lines.english: I suggest lozenges and a syrup.
lines.note: tabletki do ssania = lozenges (lit. tablets to suck)

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is a prescription needed?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, both are available without a prescription.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Ile razy dziennie mam je brać?
lines.english: How many times a day should I take them?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Syrop trzy razy dziennie po jedzeniu, tabletki co dwie godziny.
lines.english: The syrup three times a day after meals, the lozenges every two hours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. I'll take both, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Razem trzydzieści dwa złote. Proszę o paragon?
lines.english: Thirty-two zloty altogether. Would you like a receipt?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, please. Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Get well soon! Goodbye.
lines.note: Zdrowia życzę = a common pharmacy farewell

title: Buying a train ticket
description: Buying a one-way train ticket, asking about reservation, price, and platform.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Poproszę bilet do Krakowa.
lines.english: Good morning. A ticket to Kraków, please.
lines.note: poproszę is a natural polite way to ask for something at a counter.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: One way or return?
lines.note: w jedną stronę = one way; bilet powrotny = return ticket.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: One way, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Which train?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: The train at ten thirty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Second class?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes. Do I need to reserve a seat?
lines.note: muszę + infinitive means 'I have to' or 'do I need to' in questions.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, a reservation isn't necessary.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How much is the ticket?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sixty-eight zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Please tap your card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dziękuję. Z którego peronu odjeżdża pociąg?
lines.english: Thank you. Which platform does the train leave from?
lines.note: z którego peronu uses the genitive after z when asking 'from which platform?'

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: From platform three. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, goodbye.

title: Asking about a train departure
description: Asking when a train leaves, where it departs from, and whether it is direct.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. O której odjeżdża następny pociąg do Gdańska?
lines.english: Good morning. What time does the next train to Gdańsk leave?
lines.note: o której asks 'at what time?'

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: At eleven fifteen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: From which platform?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: From platform five.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is it a direct train?
lines.note: bezpośredni = direct, with no change required.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, you don't need to change trains.
lines.note: przesiadać się = to change from one train, bus, or tram to another.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Does it stop in Malbork?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, zatrzymuje się tam na kilka minut.
lines.english: Yes, it stops there for a few minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How long is the journey to Gdańsk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About three hours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is the train leaving on time?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, na razie nie ma opóźnienia.
lines.english: Yes, there is no delay at the moment.
lines.note: na razie = for now / at the moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, thank you for the information.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome. Have a good journey.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, goodbye.

title: Dealing with a delayed train
description: Checking a train delay, expected departure time, platform, and connection.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Czy pociąg do Poznania jest opóźniony?
lines.english: Good morning. Is the train to Poznań delayed?
lines.note: opóźniony = delayed.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, ma około dwudziestu pięciu minut opóźnienia.
lines.english: Yes, it is about twenty-five minutes late.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What time will it leave now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: At about two forty p.m.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy nadal odjeżdża z peronu drugiego?
lines.english: Is it still leaving from platform two?
lines.note: nadal = still, continuing to be the case.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, the platform hasn't changed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Mam przesiadkę w Poznaniu. Czy zdążę?
lines.english: I have a connection in Poznań. Will I make it?
lines.note: zdążyć means to make it in time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Ma pan trzydzieści minut na przesiadkę.
lines.english: You have thirty minutes to change trains.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I check the next train?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak. Następny jest o szesnastej dziesięć.
lines.english: Yes. The next one is at four ten p.m.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right. I'll wait for the first one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please listen for announcements at the station.
lines.note: komunikat on a station is an announcement or public information message.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for your help. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: You're welcome. Goodbye.

title: Lost luggage
description: Reporting a missing suitcase and giving details so staff can look for it.

roles.B: Pracownik biura rzeczy znalezionych · Lost property staff

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Nie mogę znaleźć mojej walizki.
lines.english: Good morning. I can't find my suitcase.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Where did you last see it?
lines.note: walizka is feminine, so ją means 'it' here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: W pociągu z Warszawy do Krakowa.
lines.english: On the train from Warsaw to Kraków.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What does the suitcase look like?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Jest duża, czarna i ma czerwony pasek.
lines.english: It's large and black, with a red strap.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Does it have a label with your name?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Tak, jest tam moje nazwisko i numer telefonu.
lines.english: Yes, my name and phone number are on it.
lines.note: nazwisko means surname or family name.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What's inside?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Clothes, shoes, and a small toiletry bag.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please fill in this form.
lines.note: wypełnić formularz = to fill in a form.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobrze. Czy mogę podać też adres hotelu?
lines.english: All right. Can I also give the hotel address?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, proszę. Skontaktujemy się z panem, jeśli znajdziemy walizkę.
lines.english: Yes, please. We'll contact you if we find the suitcase.
lines.note: z panem is the polite form used when speaking to a male customer; to a woman: z panią.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dziękuję. Mam nadzieję, że się znajdzie.
lines.english: Thank you. I hope it turns up.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: We'll do what we can. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, goodbye.

title: Taking a taxi
description: Taking a taxi to a hotel, asking about the fare, payment, and where to stop.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. Where are we going?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Proszę mnie zawieźć pod ten adres.
lines.english: Good morning. Please take me to this address.
lines.note: pod + address is common when asking to be taken to a specific building or address.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: To hotel przy ulicy Długiej, tak?
lines.english: That's the hotel on Długa Street, right?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Tak. Ile mniej więcej kosztuje przejazd?
lines.english: Yes. About how much will the ride cost?
lines.note: mniej więcej = more or less / approximately.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Około czterdziestu złotych, jeśli nie ma korków.
lines.english: About forty zloty, if there isn't much traffic.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right. Please turn on the meter.
lines.note: taksometr = taxi meter.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Do you have a lot of luggage?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Just one suitcase.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobrze. Dojazd zajmie około piętnastu minut.
lines.english: All right. The drive will take about fifteen minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, by card or cash.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Proszę zatrzymać się tutaj, przed wejściem.
lines.english: Please stop here, in front of the entrance.
lines.note: zatrzymać się = to stop; proszę zatrzymać się is a polite request.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Jasne. To będzie trzydzieści osiem złotych.
lines.english: Sure. That will be thirty-eight zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Kartą, proszę. Czy mogę dostać paragon?
lines.english: By card, please. Can I get a receipt?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Here you are. Have a nice day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, goodbye.

title: Renting a bicycle
description: Renting a bicycle for a day and asking about price, lock, return time, and payment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Chcę wypożyczyć rower na jeden dzień.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to rent a bicycle for one day.
lines.note: wypożyczyć = to rent or borrow for a limited time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: A city bike or a trekking bike?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: A city bike, please. How much is the rental?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Sixty zloty per day.
lines.note: za dzień = per day / for a day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is a lock included in the price?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, zapięcie i kask są w cenie.
lines.english: Yes, a lock and helmet are included.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Świetnie. O której muszę oddać rower?
lines.english: Great. What time do I have to return the bike?
lines.note: oddać means to return something you have borrowed or rented.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: By seven p.m. at the latest.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes. I also need an identity document.
lines.note: dokument tożsamości = identity document or ID.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Here you are, this is my passport.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dziękuję. Proszę sprawdzić hamulce i siodełko.
lines.english: Thank you. Please check the brakes and saddle.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Everything is fine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Świetnie. Miłej jazdy i do zobaczenia wieczorem.
lines.english: Great. Enjoy the ride and see you this evening.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you, see you.

title: Asking for directions
description: Asking a local how to walk to the railway station and checking the route.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Przepraszam, gdzie jest dworzec główny?
lines.english: Good morning. Excuse me, where is the main station?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. It's not far.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How can I get there?
lines.note: dostać się = to get to a place.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Go straight ahead to the traffic lights.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: And then?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Na światłach proszę skręcić w lewo.
lines.english: At the lights, turn left.
lines.note: skręcić w lewo / w prawo = turn left / right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy dworzec jest po lewej stronie?
lines.english: Is the station on the left?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Nie, po prawej, naprzeciwko dużego hotelu.
lines.english: No, on the right, opposite a large hotel.
lines.note: naprzeciwko + genitive: naprzeciwko hotelu.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How far is it from here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About ten minutes on foot.
lines.note: pieszo = on foot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy po drodze jest jakiś znak?
lines.english: Is there any sign on the way?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, zobaczy pan znak z napisem „Dworzec Główny”.
lines.english: Yes, you'll see a sign saying 'Main Station'.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, I think I understand.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Prosto, potem w lewo i dworzec będzie po prawej.
lines.english: Straight ahead, then left, and the station will be on the right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Bardzo dziękuję za pomoc. Do widzenia.
lines.english: Thank you very much for your help. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Nie ma za co. Do widzenia.
lines.english: You're welcome. Goodbye.

title: Finding a hotel
description: Asking at tourist information for an inexpensive nearby hotel with a single room.

roles.B: Pracowniczka informacji turystycznej · Tourist information clerk

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Szukam niedrogiego hotelu w centrum.
lines.english: Good morning. I'm looking for an inexpensive hotel in the city centre.
lines.note: szukam + genitive: szukam hotelu.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: For how many nights?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Na dwie noce. Potrzebuję pokoju jednoosobowego.
lines.english: For two nights. I need a single room.
lines.note: pokój jednoosobowy = single room.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Polecam hotel Amber. Jest blisko rynku.
lines.english: I recommend the Amber Hotel. It's close to the market square.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How much is the room per night?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Około dwustu czterdziestu złotych ze śniadaniem.
lines.english: About 240 zloty with breakfast.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy może pani polecić coś tańszego?
lines.english: Could you recommend something cheaper?
lines.note: Czy może pani... is a polite way to address a female staff member.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak. Pensjonat Park kosztuje sto osiemdziesiąt złotych.
lines.english: Yes. Park Guesthouse costs 180 zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is it far from here?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, about fifteen minutes on foot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you have the address?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes. 12 Zielona Street.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy może mi pani pokazać na mapie?
lines.english: Could you show me on the map?
lines.note: na mapie = on the map; locative case after na for location.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

title: Checking into a hotel
description: Checking in with a reservation, showing ID, and asking about breakfast and the room.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. Welcome to the hotel.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Mam rezerwację na nazwisko Brown.
lines.english: Good morning. I have a reservation under the name Brown.
lines.note: na nazwisko + surname = under the name of.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Już sprawdzam. Rezerwacja na trzy noce, zgadza się?
lines.english: I'll check. A reservation for three nights, correct?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, that's correct.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Czy mogę prosić o paszport albo dowód osobisty?
lines.english: May I see your passport or ID card?
lines.note: Czy mogę prosić o... is a standard polite request.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dziękuję. Pokój jest na czwartym piętrze.
lines.english: Thank you. The room is on the fourth floor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is there a lift in the hotel?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, winda jest po prawej stronie.
lines.english: Yes, the lift is on the right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What time is breakfast?
lines.note: o której = at what time.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Od siódmej do dziesiątej, na parterze.
lines.english: From seven to ten, on the ground floor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is Wi-Fi free?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak. Hasło jest na karcie do pokoju.
lines.english: Yes. The password is on the room card.
lines.note: hasło can mean password in this context.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great. Thank you for the information.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę bardzo. Oto karta do pokoju. Miłego pobytu.
lines.english: You're welcome. Here's your room card. Enjoy your stay.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

title: Making requests at a hotel
description: Asking reception for a key, clean towel, extra blanket, breakfast time, and a wake-up call.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good evening. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. Czy mogę prosić o klucz do pokoju sto osiem?
lines.english: Good evening. Could I have the key to room 108?
lines.note: Czy mogę prosić o... is a very useful polite request pattern.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. I have one more request.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Ręcznik w moim pokoju nie jest czysty.
lines.english: The towel in my room isn't clean.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'm sorry. We'll bring a clean towel right away.
lines.note: zaraz = right away / in a moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy mogę też prosić o dodatkowy koc?
lines.english: Could I also have an extra blanket?
lines.note: prosić o + accusative: prosić o koc, ręcznik, klucz.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What time is breakfast tomorrow?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: From seven to ten.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy mogą mnie państwo obudzić o szóstej trzydzieści?
lines.english: Could you wake me at six thirty?
lines.note: państwo is a polite way to address staff or a group collectively.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, zapisuję pobudkę na szóstą trzydzieści.
lines.english: Yes, I'll schedule a wake-up call for six thirty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: To wszystko. Bardzo dziękuję za pomoc.
lines.english: That's all. Thank you very much for your help.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Nie ma za co. Spokojnej nocy.
lines.english: You're welcome. Have a restful night.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Good night.

title: Reporting a problem with a hotel room
description: Reporting that the air conditioning does not work and asking for help or another room.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good evening. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. Mam problem z pokojem.
lines.english: Good evening. I have a problem with my room.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What happened?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Klimatyzacja nie działa, a w pokoju jest bardzo gorąco.
lines.english: The air conditioning isn't working, and the room is very hot.
lines.note: nie działa = it does not work; useful for equipment and machines.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Rozumiem. Jaki ma pan numer pokoju?
lines.english: I understand. What is your room number?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Two hundred and fourteen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I can send someone from the staff.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobrze. Czy może ktoś przyjść teraz?
lines.english: All right. Can someone come now?
lines.note: Czy może ktoś... is a natural way to ask if someone can do something.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, in about ten minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: A jeśli nie da się naprawić klimatyzacji?
lines.english: And if the air conditioning cannot be fixed?
lines.note: nie da się + infinitive = it cannot be done / it is not possible to do.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Then we can offer another room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is there a quieter room?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, mamy jeden od strony podwórka.
lines.english: Yes, we have one facing the courtyard.
lines.note: od strony... = on the side facing...

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great. Thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę bardzo. Zaraz się tym zajmiemy.
lines.english: You're welcome. We'll take care of it right away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Good night.

title: Checking out of a hotel
description: Checking out, asking for the bill, paying, and leaving luggage at reception.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to check out.
lines.note: wymeldować się = to check out of a hotel.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. What is your room number?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: One hundred and twenty-three.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Już sprawdzam. Czy korzystał pan z minibaru?
lines.english: I'll check. Did you use the minibar?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No, I didn't.
lines.note: korzystać z + genitive: korzystać z minibaru.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: W takim razie razem jest pięćset czterdzieści złotych.
lines.english: In that case, the total is 540 zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, of course. Please tap your card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I get an invoice?
lines.note: faktura = invoice; paragon = receipt.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak. Na firmę czy na osobę prywatną?
lines.english: Yes. For a company or a private individual?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: For a private individual, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are. Is that everything?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy mogę zostawić bagaż do popołudnia?
lines.english: Can I leave my luggage here until the afternoon?
lines.note: zostawić bagaż = to leave luggage.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. The luggage room is next to reception.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

title: Buying a SIM card
description: Buying a prepaid SIM card and asking about data, calls, activation, and price.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Chcę kupić kartę SIM.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to buy a SIM card.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Prepaid or contract?
lines.note: na kartę = prepaid; abonament = contract / monthly plan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Prepaid, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: How much data do you need?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: About twenty gigabytes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Mamy pakiet z dwudziestoma pięcioma gigabajtami.
lines.english: We have a package with twenty-five gigabytes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy rozmowy w Polsce są w cenie?
lines.english: Are calls within Poland included?
lines.note: w cenie = included in the price.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, rozmowy i SMS-y są bez limitu.
lines.english: Yes, calls and texts are unlimited.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How much is this package?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thirty-five zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Does the card work immediately?
lines.note: od razu = immediately / right away.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, ale trzeba ją najpierw zarejestrować.
lines.english: Yes, but it has to be registered first.
lines.note: trzeba + infinitive = it is necessary to / one has to.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right. I'll take that package.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę pokazać paszport. Zaraz wszystko aktywujemy.
lines.english: Please show your passport. We'll activate everything in a moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much.

title: Using internet and printing services
description: Asking to use a computer, print documents, and pay for the service.

roles.B: Pracownik punktu usługowego · Service desk staff

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Czy mogę skorzystać z komputera?
lines.english: Good morning. Can I use a computer?
lines.note: skorzystać z + genitive: skorzystać z komputera.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes. Do you need internet access?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Tak, i chcę też wydrukować dwa dokumenty.
lines.english: Yes, and I also want to print two documents.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dokumenty są na pendrivie czy w e-mailu?
lines.english: Are the documents on a USB drive or in your email?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: In my email.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę usiąść przy komputerze numer trzy.
lines.english: Please sit at computer number three.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How much does internet use cost?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Ten zloty per hour.
lines.note: za godzinę = per hour.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: A ile kosztuje jedna strona wydruku?
lines.english: And how much is one printed page?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: One zloty per black-and-white page.
lines.note: czarno-biały = black and white.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right. I only need two pages.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę wysłać plik na ten adres e-mail.
lines.english: Please send the file to this email address.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Done. Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes. Twelve zloty altogether.
lines.note: razem = altogether / in total.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Sending a parcel at the post office
description: Sending a parcel abroad and asking about delivery options, price, and tracking.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Chcę wysłać tę paczkę do Niemiec.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to send this parcel to Germany.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Standard or priority?
lines.note: przesyłka priorytetowa is priority mail.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Priorytetową, proszę. Ile idzie taka paczka?
lines.english: Priority, please. How long does a parcel like that take?
lines.note: Ile idzie...? is a common spoken way to ask how long delivery takes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Zwykle trzy do pięciu dni roboczych.
lines.english: Usually three to five business days.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How much is postage?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: First I need to weigh the parcel.
lines.note: zważyć = to weigh.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Of course.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Paczka waży dwa i pół kilograma. Cena to sześćdziesiąt dwa złote.
lines.english: The parcel weighs two and a half kilograms. The price is 62 zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy mogę dostać numer do śledzenia przesyłki?
lines.english: Can I get a tracking number?
lines.note: śledzenie przesyłki = shipment tracking.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, the number will be on the confirmation.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do I need to fill in a form?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, proszę wpisać adres nadawcy i odbiorcy.
lines.english: Yes, please enter the sender's and recipient's addresses.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right. Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Here you are, this is your confirmation.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Exchanging and withdrawing money at a bank
titlePolish: Wymiana i wypłata pieniędzy w banku
description: Asking about the exchange rate, commission, and withdrawing cash from an account.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Chcę wymienić euro na złote.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to exchange euros for zloty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What amount?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dwieście euro. Jaki jest dzisiaj kurs?
lines.english: Two hundred euros. What is today's exchange rate?
lines.note: kurs here means exchange rate.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Jedno euro to cztery złote i trzydzieści groszy.
lines.english: One euro is 4.30 zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is there a commission fee?
lines.note: prowizja = commission or service fee.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, five zloty per transaction.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobrze. Chcę też wypłacić trzysta złotych z konta.
lines.english: All right. I'd also like to withdraw 300 zloty from my account.
lines.note: wypłacić pieniądze = to withdraw money.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Czy ma pan kartę i dokument tożsamości?
lines.english: Do you have your card and ID?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, here you are.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you. Please enter your PIN.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Done.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Do you need a confirmation?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, please.
lines.note: poproszę is natural when requesting a document or item at a counter.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are. That's everything.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for your help. Goodbye.

title: Buying a museum ticket
description: Buying a museum ticket and asking about discounts, opening hours, and photography.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Poproszę jeden bilet normalny.
lines.english: Good morning. One regular ticket, please.
lines.note: bilet normalny = full-price ticket.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Czy ma pan prawo do zniżki?
lines.english: Are you eligible for a discount?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Jestem studentem. Czy jest zniżka studencka?
lines.english: I'm a student. Is there a student discount?
lines.note: zniżka studencka = student discount.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, with a valid student ID.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Here you are, this is my student ID.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: W takim razie bilet kosztuje dwadzieścia złotych.
lines.english: In that case, the ticket costs twenty zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Do której muzeum jest dziś otwarte?
lines.english: Until what time is the museum open today?
lines.note: Do której...? asks 'until what time?'

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Do osiemnastej. Ostatnie wejście jest o siedemnastej trzydzieści.
lines.english: Until six p.m. Last admission is at five thirty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I take photos?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, but without flash.
lines.note: lampa błyskowa = camera flash.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is the audio guide included in the price?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, it costs an additional ten zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, I'll take an audio guide as well.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are. Enjoy your visit.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much.

title: Joining a sightseeing tour
description: Asking about the next guided tour, duration, language, price, and what is included.

roles.B: Pracownik biura turystycznego · Tour office staff

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Chcę pojechać na wycieczkę po mieście.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to go on a city tour.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Najbliższa wycieczka zaczyna się o jedenastej.
lines.english: The next tour starts at eleven.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How long does the tour last?
lines.note: Ile trwa...? = How long does ... last?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About three hours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Does the guide speak English?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, wycieczka jest po polsku i po angielsku.
lines.english: Yes, the tour is in Polish and English.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What is included in the ticket price?
lines.note: w cenie = included in the price.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Przewodnik, transport i wejście do muzeum.
lines.english: The guide, transport, and museum admission.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: And lunch?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: No, lunch is not included.
lines.note: wliczony = included in the total price.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Ile kosztuje bilet dla jednej osoby?
lines.english: How much is a ticket for one person?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: One hundred and twenty zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, one ticket please.
lines.note: poproszę + accusative is a standard polite purchasing pattern.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę bardzo. Zbiórka jest przed biurem o dziesiątej pięćdziesiąt.
lines.english: Here you are. The meeting point is in front of the office at ten fifty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. See you.

title: Looking for an item in a shop
description: Looking for a specific product, asking about alternatives, price, and guarantee.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Czy mogę w czymś pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. Can I help you with anything?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Szukam małej ładowarki do telefonu.
lines.english: Good morning. I'm looking for a small phone charger.
lines.note: szukam + genitive: szukam ładowarki.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: For what kind of phone?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: For a phone with a USB-C port.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Mamy kilka modeli. Ten jest najmniejszy.
lines.english: We have several models. This one is the smallest.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I see it?
lines.note: go refers to a masculine object, here model.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do you have anything cheaper?
lines.note: mają państwo is a polite plural/formal way to ask store staff.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, ten model kosztuje pięćdziesiąt dziewięć złotych.
lines.english: Yes, this model costs fifty-nine zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Does it have a guarantee?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, two years.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Is there a cable in the box?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, the cable is included.
lines.note: w zestawie = included with the product / in the set.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, I'll take this model.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please go to the checkout. Thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Shopping at an outlet
description: Looking for discounted shoes, trying another size, checking the discount, and paying.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Szukam butów sportowych na wyprzedaży.
lines.english: Good morning. I'm looking for sports shoes on sale.
lines.note: szukam + genitive: szukam butów.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What size do you wear?
lines.note: To a woman, say: Jaki rozmiar pani nosi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czterdzieści dwa. Czy mogę przymierzyć ten model?
lines.english: Forty-two. Can I try on this model?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Są trochę za ciasne. Czy jest rozmiar czterdzieści trzy?
lines.english: They're a little too tight. Do you have size forty-three?
lines.note: za ciasne = too tight; za + adjective often means 'too...'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I'll check in the back room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are, we have size forty-three.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Te pasują dobrze. Jaka jest zniżka?
lines.english: These fit well. What is the discount?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Forty percent off the regular price.
lines.note: od ceny regularnej = off the regular price.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How much are they after the discount?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Two hundred and nineteen zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, I'll take them. I'll pay by card.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę bardzo. Oto paragon. Miłego dnia.
lines.english: Here you are. Here's your receipt. Have a nice day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Trying on clothes and shoes
description: Trying on a jacket and shoes, asking for another size, and checking the fit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Chcę przymierzyć tę kurtkę.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to try on this jacket.
lines.note: przymierzyć = to try on clothes or shoes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. What size do you wear?
lines.note: To a woman, say: Jaki rozmiar pani nosi?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Usually medium.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę bardzo. Przymierzalnia jest po prawej.
lines.english: Here you are. The fitting room is on the right.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dziękuję. Ta kurtka jest trochę za ciasna.
lines.english: Thank you. This jacket is a little too tight.
lines.note: za + adjective means 'too...', for example za ciasna = too tight.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I can bring a large.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Tak, proszę. I czy mogę przymierzyć te buty?
lines.english: Yes, please. And can I try on these shoes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What size?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Forty-two.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę. Tu jest rozmiar czterdzieści dwa.
lines.english: Here you are. This is size forty-two.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Buty pasują dobrze, ale kurtka jest za duża.
lines.english: The shoes fit well, but the jacket is too big.
lines.note: pasować = to fit or suit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Może pan spróbować innego modelu w rozmiarze M.
lines.english: You can try another model in medium.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll bring it right away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much.

title: Paying in a shop
description: Paying for purchases, choosing card or cash, and asking for a receipt.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. Is that everything?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good morning. Yes, that's everything.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: That's eighty-six zloty altogether.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I pay by card?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes. By card or phone?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: By card, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please tap your card on the terminal.
lines.note: przyłożyć kartę = to tap or hold the card against the terminal.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Do I need to enter my PIN?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, please enter your PIN.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Done.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Payment accepted.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can I get a receipt?
lines.note: paragon = receipt; faktura = invoice.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Do you need a bag?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No, thank you. I have my own.
lines.note: własną agrees with torbę, which is feminine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are. Have a nice day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Returning a faulty product
description: Returning faulty headphones and asking for an exchange or refund.

roles.B: Pracownik działu reklamacji · Returns desk staff

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Chcę zwrócić te słuchawki.
lines.english: Good morning. I'd like to return these headphones.
lines.note: zwrócić = to return an item to a shop.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What's wrong with them?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: One earpiece doesn't work.
lines.note: nie działa = it doesn't work.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: When did you buy them?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Three days ago.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Do you have the receipt?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, here you are.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dziękuję. Może pan wymienić słuchawki na nowe.
lines.english: Thank you. You can exchange the headphones for new ones.
lines.note: wymienić na + accusative = exchange for something.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'd prefer a refund.
lines.note: Male: wolałbym. Female: wolałabym.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobrze. Zwrot będzie na kartę, którą pan płacił.
lines.english: All right. The refund will go back to the card you used.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How long will that take?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Zwykle od dwóch do pięciu dni.
lines.english: Usually two to five days.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I understand. Do I need to sign anything?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, please sign here. Thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you for your help. Goodbye.

title: Buying a book or newspaper
description: Looking for a Polish phrasebook and an English-language newspaper in a bookshop.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. Can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Szukam rozmówek polskich dla początkujących.
lines.english: Good morning. I'm looking for a Polish phrasebook for beginners.
lines.note: szukam + genitive: szukam rozmówek.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Mamy kilka. Woli pan książkę po polsku czy z angielskim tłumaczeniem?
lines.english: We have several. Do you prefer a book in Polish or with English translations?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: With English translations, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please have a look at this book.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Czy jest też wersja z nagraniami?
lines.english: Is there also a version with recordings?
lines.note: nagrania = recordings, for example audio recordings.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, ta wersja ma dostęp do nagrań online.
lines.english: Yes, this version includes access to online recordings.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How much is it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Forty-nine zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobrze. Czy mają państwo też gazetę po angielsku?
lines.english: All right. Do you also have a newspaper in English?
lines.note: mają państwo is a polite way to ask shop staff what they have.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, the newspapers are by the checkout.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Poproszę jedną gazetę i tę książkę.
lines.english: I'll take one newspaper and this book.
lines.note: poproszę is natural when choosing something to buy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. That's sixty-one zloty altogether.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'll pay by card.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are. Have a nice day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Ordering coffee at a café
description: Ordering coffee and a snack, choosing milk and takeaway, and paying.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good morning. What can I get you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Poproszę dużą kawę z mlekiem.
lines.english: Good morning. A large coffee with milk, please.
lines.note: poproszę is the standard polite way to order at a café.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Regular milk or plant-based milk?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Oat milk, please.
lines.note: mleko owsiane = oat milk.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: For here or to go?
lines.note: na miejscu = for here; na wynos = to go.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Na wynos. I poproszę jeszcze rogalika.
lines.english: To go. And I'll also have a croissant.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: With chocolate or plain?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: With chocolate, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Anything else?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No, thank you. How much is it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Twenty-nine zloty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'll pay by card.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please tap your card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Done.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you. Your coffee will be ready in a moment.
lines.note: za chwilę = in a moment / shortly.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

title: Getting a table at a restaurant
description: Asking for a table, choosing where to sit, and asking about the wait.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Good evening. Welcome.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. Poproszę stolik dla dwóch osób.
lines.english: Good evening. A table for two, please.
lines.note: stolik dla dwóch osób = a table for two people.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No, we don't.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: W środku jest wolny stolik. Na zewnątrz trzeba poczekać.
lines.english: There is a free table inside. For outside seating, you'll need to wait.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Ile trzeba czekać na stolik na zewnątrz?
lines.english: How long is the wait for a table outside?
lines.note: trzeba + infinitive expresses that something is necessary.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: About fifteen minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: W takim razie usiądziemy w środku.
lines.english: In that case, we'll sit inside.
lines.note: w takim razie = in that case.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Please follow me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Can we sit by the window?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, this table is free.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Great. Can we have the menu?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. Here you are.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dziękuję. Czy mają państwo menu po angielsku?
lines.english: Thank you. Do you have an English menu?
lines.note: mają państwo is polite when addressing restaurant staff.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, I'll bring one right away.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much.

title: Ordering a meal
description: Asking for a recommendation, ordering a main dish and drink, and requesting the bill.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. Czy są państwo gotowi zamówić?
lines.english: Good evening. Are you ready to order?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. Jeszcze nie. Co pani poleca?
lines.english: Good evening. Not yet. What do you recommend?
lines.note: To a male waiter: Co pan poleca? To a female waiter: Co pani poleca?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Polecam pierogi z mięsem albo z kapustą i grzybami.
lines.english: I recommend pierogi with meat or with cabbage and mushrooms.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Poproszę pierogi z kapustą i grzybami.
lines.english: I'll have the pierogi with cabbage and mushrooms.
lines.note: poproszę is natural and polite when ordering food.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: And to drink?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Still mineral water, please.
lines.note: bez gazu = still; z gazem = sparkling.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Small or large?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Large.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Anything else?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Not for now, thank you.
lines.note: na razie = for now / at the moment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobrze. Zamówienie będzie za około piętnaście minut.
lines.english: All right. Your order will be ready in about fifteen minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, the bill please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Of course. That's sixty-four zloty altogether.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I'll pay by card. Thank you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Explaining a food allergy or special diet
titlePolish: Alergia i specjalna dieta w restauracji
description: Explaining a nut allergy and asking which dishes are safe to order.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. Czy mogę przyjąć zamówienie?
lines.english: Good evening. May I take your order?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobry wieczór. Najpierw mam pytanie. Mam uczulenie na orzechy.
lines.english: Good evening. First I have a question. I'm allergic to nuts.
lines.note: Mam uczulenie na... = I'm allergic to...

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I understand. Is the allergy severe?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Tak. Nie mogę jeść żadnych orzechów.
lines.english: Yes. I can't eat any nuts.
lines.note: nie mogę + infinitive = I cannot / I'm not able to.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: I'll check the ingredients in the dishes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Does this soup contain nuts?
lines.note: zawierać = to contain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Nie, ale jest przygotowywana w tej samej kuchni.
lines.english: No, but it is prepared in the same kitchen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: And is the salad safe?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak, możemy przygotować ją bez sosu z orzechami.
lines.english: Yes, we can prepare it without the nut sauce.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dobrze. Czy ma w sobie produkty mleczne?
lines.english: All right. Does it contain dairy products?

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Yes, there is cheese in the sauce.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: W takim razie poproszę sałatkę bez sosu.
lines.english: In that case, I'll have the salad without the sauce.
lines.note: bez + genitive: bez sosu, bez cukru, bez mleka.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Oczywiście. Powiem też kucharzowi o alergii.
lines.english: Of course. I'll also tell the cook about the allergy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę bardzo. Zaraz przyjmę resztę zamówienia.
lines.english: You're welcome. I'll take the rest of your order in a moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right, thank you.

title: Going to a doctor or pharmacy
description: Describing simple symptoms and asking what to take for a sore throat and fever.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. Od dwóch dni źle się czuję.
lines.english: Good morning. I've been feeling unwell for two days.
lines.note: źle się czuję = I feel unwell.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: What symptoms do you have?
lines.note: objawy = symptoms.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Mam ból gardła, kaszel i gorączkę.
lines.english: I have a sore throat, a cough, and a fever.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: How high is the fever?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: About thirty-eight degrees.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Czy ma pan jakieś alergie na leki?
lines.english: Do you have any allergies to medicines?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
lines.note: Mam alergię na... is another common way to say you are allergic to something.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Rozumiem. Czy bierze pan teraz jakieś leki?
lines.english: I understand. Are you taking any medicines now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Mogę zaproponować lek na ból gardła i środek przeciwgorączkowy.
lines.english: I can suggest something for the sore throat and a fever reducer.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: How often should I take it?
lines.note: brać lek = to take medicine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Proszę stosować zgodnie z ulotką. Jeśli gorączka nie spadnie, proszę skontaktować się z lekarzem.
lines.english: Please use it according to the leaflet. If the fever doesn't go down, contact a doctor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: All right. I'll take that medicine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Here you are. I hope you feel better.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

title: Reporting a lost passport at a police station
description: Reporting a lost passport, explaining where it was last seen, and asking for a police report.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dzień dobry. W czym mogę pomóc?
lines.english: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Good morning. I've lost my passport.
lines.note: Male: zgubiłem. Female: zgubiłam.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Kiedy zauważył pan, że go nie ma?
lines.english: When did you notice it was missing?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: This morning.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Gdzie miał pan paszport ostatni raz?
lines.english: Where did you have the passport last?

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Chyba wczoraj w restauracji przy rynku.
lines.english: I think yesterday at a restaurant near the market square.
lines.note: chyba = probably / I think, when you are not completely certain.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: Is anything else missing?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: No. I still have my wallet and phone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Dobrze. Proszę podać imię, nazwisko i adres w Polsce.
lines.english: All right. Please give your first name, surname, and address in Poland.
lines.note: nazwisko = surname / family name.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Nazywam się Daniel Brown. Mieszkam teraz w hotelu Centrum.
lines.english: My name is Daniel Brown. I'm currently staying at Hotel Centrum.

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Czy ma pan kopię paszportu albo inny dokument?
lines.english: Do you have a copy of your passport or another document?

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: I have a photo of the passport on my phone.

lines.speaker: B
lines.english: All right. Please fill in this form.
lines.note: wypełnić formularz = to fill in a form.

lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Will I get confirmation of the report?

lines.speaker: B
lines.polish: Tak. Z tym dokumentem może pan skontaktować się z ambasadą.
lines.english: Yes. With this document you can contact your embassy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.polish: Dziękuję bardzo za pomoc. Do widzenia.
lines.english: Thank you very much for your help. Goodbye.
